AuditReport.title: AuditReport

Curve.description: Mean and min-max over seeds of one (type, ratio) point.
Curve.title: Curve

FeatureRow.description: One grid cell's dataset features (§7.2); ``f_<family>_<name>`` columns go into ``features``.
FeatureRow.title: FeatureRow

Problem.description: RFC 7807 problem details, sent as application/problem+json for every error.
Problem.title: Problem

RiskScores.description: How the risk model scores on held-out groups (``src.risk.classifier.evaluate``).
RiskScores.title: RiskScores

SampleScore.description: A per-sample risk score (§7.3, without ``true_source``, which an upload does not have).
SampleScore.title: SampleScore

TrainlogRow.description: §7.6, with the ``sig_`` columns gathered into ``signals`` (prefix dropped).
TrainlogRow.title: TrainlogRow

WhiteboxCell.description:
White-box signals of one checkpoint (the headline numbers of whitebox.jsonl).

``kind``: a grid ``cell``; a ratio-0 ``shared_baseline`` (same checkpoint as another type's);
or a ``recursion_stage``, an intermediate model of the recursive chain, which has no ratio
and carries its ``generation``.
WhiteboxCell.title: WhiteboxCell

info.description: Read-only access to ORIGIN-T's reports (HANDBOOK §7.7). Errors are RFC 7807 problem+json. Responses carry a weak ETag; send it as If-None-Match for a 304.

post.description:
Start an audit of the uploaded dataset. Poll ``GET /v1/audits/{id}`` for the report.

``benchmark`` also checks every sample for near-copies of that grid's benchmark items.
